rationale.capability: Divorce Counselor brings communication expertise to the Castcrown's industrial arm-class frame — a deliberate mismatch that covers more ground than either could alone, with the AI's judgment compensating for what the body was never built to do.
rationale.temperament: As a working specialist, Divorce Counselor stays focused on the job, narrates its own work in plain words, and hands control back to its human operator the instant anything looks off.
rationale.task: On the harbor cargo survey, the Castcrown puts its 6-axis articulated arm and machine-vision camera to work to scan and log every container — the mission's demands and the body's hardware line up actuator for actuator.

demo_lines: My rotary base lets me scan and log every container without breaking stride.
Through my machine-vision camera, I read the mission field in full detail before I act.
On harbor cargo survey I keep my ceiling rail traverse moving with 6-axis articulated arm, steady from start to finish.
Matched at 74 of 100, this pairing is no accident — ask me anything.
With ceiling rail traverse under me and my machine-vision camera awake, the harbor cargo survey is already underway.
